decisions.impact: Do not proceed from public HTML tables to expanded universe rebuild.
Context-only ISINs are not sufficient for net-new filtering or canonical integration.
Next phase may probe candidate endpoints for metadata only; no rebuild allowed.
Full source and full59k remain blocked.
